Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company Increases Stake in 3M Co (MMM); As Enbridge (ENB) Stock Declined, Old Point Trust & Financial Services N A Increased Holding 
April 18, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia 
Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company increased its stake in 3M Co (MMM) by 66.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company bought 3,379 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.03% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,474 shares of the medical and dental instruments company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.99 million, up from 5,095 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company who had been investing in 3M Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $130.89B market cap company. The stock increased 1.10% or $2.39 during the last trading session, reaching $220.09. About 1.85 million shares traded. 3M Company (NYSE:MMM) has risen 13.36% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.81% the S&P500. 
Old Point Trust & Financial Services N A increased its stake in Enbridge Inc (ENB) by 8.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Old Point Trust & Financial Services N A bought 9,926 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 128,122 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.01M, up from 118,196 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Old Point Trust& Financial Services N A who had been investing in Enbridge Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $54.03B market cap company. The stock increased 1.17% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $32.97. About 3.25 million shares traded. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 26.13% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.68% the S&P500. 
Old Point Trust & Financial Services N A, which manages about $184.93 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Centurylink Inc (NYSE:CTL) by 22,716 shares to 68,796 shares, valued at $1.15 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. 
Among 16 analysts covering Enbridge Inc. ( NYSE:ENB ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. Enbridge Inc. had 25 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Goldman Sachs downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Wednesday, July 20 report. Morgan Stanley maintained Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) rating on Friday, July 14. Morgan Stanley has “Equal-Weight” rating and $44 target. The rating was downgraded by National Bank Canada to “Sector Perform” on Monday, July 18. The stock of Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, March 14 by Credit Suisse. J.P. Morgan initiated Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) on Friday, June 23 with “Hold” rating. Credit Suisse maintained the stock with “Neutral” rating in Tuesday, March 8 report. The stock of Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Friday, March 23. The stock has “Neutral” rating by JP Morgan on Friday, June 23. The company was maintained on Friday, February 9 by Morgan Stanley. The firm has “Market Perform” rating given on Monday, May 15 by Wolfe Research.
